Chapter 92 Procrastination (For Subscription)

Afterwards, under the command of Patriarch Jones, the heads of various cities were surrounded by the people of Patriarch Jones who were waiting to be cleaned up. After some explanations and announcements.

Except for a few stubborn diehards who ran out without knowing what to do, they wanted to avenge their dead patriarch, and then they were prepared to kill them easily, without even causing a little confusion.

Then the rest of the people looked around and saw that there were obviously several times more enemies than themselves, and they chose to surrender very wisely. After all, they also wanted to live, and let them fight for a so-called Creland tribe. The Deira Alliance gave their lives to protect the existence of the two of them who usually exploited their own tribe.

Even some stupid barbarians usually felt a bit of resentment in their hearts, and when they saw such a sharp attack from the enemies outside their city before, they felt a little bit of fear in their hearts.

Now in my stronghold, most of the people choose to surrender, only my stupid patriarchs resist to the death, disregarding the lives of their own people, they say in their hearts that it is impossible not to blame.

Right now, those patriarchs who got in the way are dead, and there is no one in charge. Even if he surrenders, there is no one to punish and blame.

These soldiers can be said to have lost one of the biggest burdens and fears in their hearts, so they, who had no burden at all, surrendered very readily after seeing those who wanted to resist in the end.

With the entire camp under Jones' control, it means that no one can stop Jones' decision to surrender. After reorganizing the soldiers who surrendered a little bit, after making sure that they really can't cause any trouble to themselves.

Jones led the walled city, and all the patriarchs and leaders in the city opened the door of growth together, opened up all their resistance to the troops outside the city, and carried out a surrender that was very humiliating to them, but conformed to their thoughts .

With the surrender of Jones' Kaesong, there is already a small-scale city stronghold in the south of the entire northern region, which can barely be said to be a stronghold of the city, and it has been brought into the hands of Zhong Yu.

At this point, Zhong Yu finally has a relatively stable foothold in the northern region, and he can start the foundation for his strategy and rule in the entire north. The most difficult step has been taken, and the next step is to continue to consume.

It depends on who can't support himself and the Edel alliance first, and falls into a disadvantage. This is destined to be a long process, and he may lose him for half a year or several months, so Zhong Yu is not in a hurry.

He still has 350,000 soldiers under his command, which is enough for him to consume in this war. As for things like food and supplies, Zhong Yu said that with his 300,000 luck points in his pocket, he is not worried about food and supplies at all. lack of things.

With money in his pocket, he doesn't panic in his heart. Now Zhong Yu, who is rich and powerful, has the momentum to use money to kill the alliance, and he is doing the same now.

The Edel Alliance is now in the tribal fishing and hunting civilization. Most of the food sources of all the tribes in the entire alliance come from fishing and hunting those wild animals. As for the cultivation of food and grass crops, sorry, most of the clumsy barbarians said, listen I have never heard of this kind of food that can be eaten.

Except for their tribal leaders, because they have enough strength and insight, they learned a little bit about the rough slash-and-burn farming in the Kingdom of Ryan in the north. He has planted a small area of wheat arable land, and he can probably feed one or two thousand people with this grain throughout the year, and there will be nothing more.

As for the cultivation of these grains, in order to reflect their different identities from ordinary tribesmen, those nobles deliberately imitated and learned from those nobles of the Ryan Kingdom who represented the trend of the entire plain in their eyes.

Therefore, it is impossible to expect any food reserves in the entire alliance, not to mention the alliance, and even the entire plain, the three major forces do not have much food reserves.

Except for the kingdom in the north with a more advanced civilization, which has a little sense of crisis and has stored his grain for about three months, the other two large tribal alliances only have his grain reserves for about one month.

This is not too surprising. After all, the food they hunted is basically meat, which is not very convenient to store. If the weather is windy, rainy, and humid, the stored food will basically rot.

That's why the food they hunted was basically eaten immediately, so how could they keep it as a food reserve? Except that in winter when there are fewer prey, he will leave him two months of food to prepare for the winter.

At other times, they prepare a month's worth of food, and it is still used to deal with the war between the three major forces that may break out at any time, so they are extremely reluctant, and reluctantly take out their rations and use them for storage.

Therefore, Zhong Yu understands that if there are no special circumstances, it is very possible to wipe out the Edra Alliance by relying on his own army of more than 350,000 to push through.

But so what? Isn't the Edra Alliance just standing there like this without any resistance?

The entire alliance, which is really pressed, can also summon his 70,000 to 80,000 soldiers, and there are thousands of extraordinary powers inside. If it is pushed flat, the loss will definitely be very heavy.

In fact, it is absolutely possible to kill half of him, so what will I use to resist the attacks of the other two major forces when I am already exhausted? That's not making wedding dresses for others. Zhong Yu, who doesn't want to suffer at all, will never do such a thing that hurts others and benefits himself.

Then I can only procrastinate until the entire alliance has been exhausted by myself, and their soldiers are so hungry that they have no energy in their bodies. When they beat all their tribes, they don't want to fight any more. There is no chance of eliminating this Edel Alliance.

These tribal alliances on the plains have a weakness that they are absolutely inferior to their own soldiers, that is, they have never fought a war that lasted more than three months.

Each war usually only lasted him for a month, and each of them retreated because of the shortage of food and grass. Except for the Ruien Kingdom in the north, because they knew how to store food better, they were able to fight for a longer time and achieve greater results. He is the strongest among the three major forces, and the factor of food is also a very important reason.

Therefore, when I fight with any major force on the plain, I don't need to attack fiercely. I just need to use a trick to station the large army on their borders. The scale of the battle made them dare not retreat because they could not survive the long-term consumption.

After entrusting him to him for a few months, they will not be able to sustain themselves due to their lack of background, and they can only let themselves slowly erode their territory, continuously injecting the last drop of their blood, and finally swallowing them completely.

The only thing I have concerns about is the gods standing behind them, a neighbor's godhead god, and two demigods who are slightly inferior but also ignited the god fire, this is the power that makes me really fearful!
